purpose: Translate source-specific FreeSurfer ROI names into workflow-standard ROI names, and record for each mapping how the standard ROI relates to the source ROI and whether a human has cleared it for quantitative or only qualitative use.

status_scheme.reviewed_quantitative_ready: Definition, atlas, unit, hemisphere and method are compatible; numeric comparison allowed.
status_scheme.reviewed_qualitative_only: Anatomically related but from a different atlas, extent or method; literature linking for interpretation only.
status_scheme.pending_human_review: Not confirmed by a reviewer; must not enter a final conclusion.
status_scheme.accepted: User approved research use; mapping relation, anatomical equivalence and quantitative compatibility remain independently checked.

mapping_relation_scheme.exact: The standard ROI and the source ROI denote the same extent.
mapping_relation_scheme.broader_than_source: The standard ROI covers more than this single source ROI.
mapping_relation_scheme.narrower_than_source: The standard ROI covers only part of this source ROI.
mapping_relation_scheme.composite_derived: The standard ROI is built from several source ROIs.
mapping_relation_scheme.unassessed: No reviewer has judged the correspondence yet.

atlas_naming_note: lh/rh.aparc.stats is the Desikan-Killiany parcellation. DKT output is lh/rh.aparc.DKTatlas.stats. The atlas is determined from the source stats file, never from the ROI names, because DK and DKT share parcel names.

mappings.translation_rule: Exact native aseg label identity; no cross-atlas harmonization
mappings.note: Native label 10 is distinct from legacy Left-Thalamus label 9. Matching this label permits source-specific research context, not a validated individual PD range or diagnosis.

mappings.translation_rule: Exact native aseg label identity; no cross-atlas harmonization
mappings.note: Native label 49 is distinct from legacy Right-Thalamus label 48. Matching this label permits source-specific research context, not a validated individual PD range or diagnosis.

mappings.translation_rule: Prespecified workflow composite of bilateral hippocampus, amygdala, entorhinal and parahippocampal volumes
mappings.note: Composite of four FreeSurfer regions. A paper reporting medial temporal lobe must not be equated with hippocampus alone, and numeric comparison requires the paper to use this same four-region definition. Review decision carried forward from minimal_atlas_translation.json v0.1, which recorded no reviewer or review date; re-attribution required.

mappings.translation_rule: Unweighted mean of available cortical thickness parcels
mappings.note: Workflow summary rather than an atlas-native ROI. An unweighted parcel mean is not the same quantity as a surface-area weighted whole-brain mean thickness.

approval_record.basis: Explicit user request: approve the currently pending records
approval_record.scope: Research use subject to measurement compatibility checks
